PIN ORDER (drain,gate,source). Every MOSFET here is drawn with four leads: three channel segments (broken bar) carrying drain / body-arrow / source, plus the continuous gate bar, and in EVERY case the drafter ties the middle body-arrow lead to the lower channel lead with a short vertical, so the lower lead is the source and the upper lead is the drain. The gate is the lead on the continuous bar (right-hand bar for #2/#3/#7/#9/#13, left-hand bar for #4/#8/#14). N-channel symbols (#2,#3,#4,#7,#13) have the body arrow pointing towards the gate bar and P-channel (#8,#9,#14) away from it, matching the annotated classes - no class looks wrong.
